changes: Nearby allied/neutral vehicle health bars appear within 20 m while the technician holds the engineering repair tool; bars hide on release. Destroyed and enemy vehicles are excluded.
Own transport repair status appears inside the front cabin when servicing from seat 7.
Front passenger seat 7 permits retrieval/stowing of the rear-mounted repair tool and tracked hands. Other seated equipment restrictions remain active.

Native C++ permits 30 HP/s repair of the own allied transport from the front passenger seat. Drivers and side pod passengers are excluded; trigger release, blocked input, stale input, untracked/unheld VR tool stop repair.

Nearby incapacitated allied players show an amber ring and centre dot to medics. White indicates a hand in reach, teal indicates the local drag gesture. Markers follow the prone body, disappear on revival, and are hidden from other classes/enemies.
Isolated loopback technician fixture starts with primary ammo 3, secondary ammo 1, and nearby allied transport HP 40/100; F8/menu reset clears existing supply boxes and restores the test.

production_arena.note: Full integration preceded the display-only reset cleanup; reset cleanup has its own subsequent visual regression check.

known_diagnostics: Existing glove material UID warnings use path fallback.
Isolated fixture shutdown reports ObjectDB/resource leaks; no gameplay script errors in successful checks.

launch.scenario: technician: low ammunition and 40 HP allied transport

live_test.reset: F8 or RESET TECHNICIAN TEST in the menu
